nodes.label: Portfolio rules
nodes.rationale: Holdings computed from transactions, never stored; full replay under lock; no market value without a real price; not trading signals.

nodes.label: Weighted-average cost accounting
nodes.rationale: Fees and taxes in cost, chronological replay, BigDecimal DECIMAL128, display rounding only (ADR 0007).

nodes.label: Original files are sources of truth
nodes.norm_label: original files are sources of truth
nodes.rationale: Original PDFs and EMLs are authoritative; DB content, links and research items are derived and regenerable. Storage keys never appear in API responses.

nodes.label: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED job claims with lease and token
nodes.norm_label: for update skip locked job claims with lease and token
nodes.rationale: Reliable background work without a message broker.

nodes.label: Spring AI 2.0 models only
nodes.rationale: Use EmbeddingModel/ChatModel only; own the vector schema instead of PgVectorStore or LangChain4j (ADR 0005).

nodes.label: Translated-copy drop rule (PRIMARY_ONLY)
nodes.rationale: Replaced a majority-language rule that lost real data in a prompt-injection email.

nodes.label: Module boundaries
nodes.rationale: Cross-module calls go only to application services; enforced by ArchitectureTest to prevent dependency cycles.

nodes.label: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh business date
nodes.rationale: Do not use @PastOrPresent for trade/price dates; it uses the JVM zone.

nodes.label: Real sample email handling
nodes.rationale: Real emails may be read locally for analysis but never copied into the repo or quoted; scratch copies deleted.

nodes.label: Failure memory (docs/failures)
nodes.rationale: Toolchain and framework pitfalls previously lived only in session transcripts; notes must have Prevention and Detection.

nodes.label: Untrusted input rules
nodes.rationale: Email URLs and HTML are untrusted: fetch only via ReportDownloader, serve HTML only via HtmlSanitizer, no generic fetch endpoint.

nodes.label: Security posture
nodes.rationale: Local only; files under server-generated names; email HTML sanitized+CSP+sandbox; external URLs allowlisted; LLM source text treated as untrusted.

nodes.label: Apache HttpClient 5 downloader
nodes.rationale: Address-validating DNS resolver plus manual redirect validation give SSRF and DNS-rebinding protection.

nodes.label: Local single-user, no authentication
nodes.rationale: No auth/authorization; backend and DB must not be exposed to untrusted networks.

nodes.label: Secure report downloads
nodes.rationale: https-only, allowlisted brokerage domains, per-hop redirect checks, DNS-level SSRF/rebinding protection, size/time limits and %PDF- validation.

nodes.label: AI / knowledge base rules
nodes.rationale: Instructions only in system message; citations built from stored chunks; never log text/prompts/keys; bump IndexVersion.PIPELINE on chunking changes; tests use fake AI.

nodes.label: Brokerage rating is not Investary advice
nodes.norm_label: brokerage rating is not investary advice
nodes.rationale: A source rating such as "Chờ mua" is copied verbatim as the brokerage statement and never presented as an Investary recommendation.

nodes.label: Index version string
nodes.rationale: Encodes pipeline, chunking, bilingual mode, provider:model and dims so vectors of different models are never compared.
